title: OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.19343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. translated_title: OmitEHR：LLM生成临床总结中可扩展的遗漏检测方法
translated_abstract: 医疗系统日益依赖大型语言模型（LLM）来起草患者医疗记录的摘要，然而评估研究发现，遗漏——即临床重要信息的缺失——是最常见的失败模式。检测LLM生成摘要中的遗漏需要知道记录中哪些事实是具有重要临床意义的，而现有方法要么手动指定这一信号，要么忽略它，要么在推理阶段使用成本高昂的LLM评判器重新计算。我们提出了OmitEHR，一种无需参考答案的遗漏检测器，它从LLM广泛应用之前的临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床显著性。OmitEHR学习预测临床医生在其摘要中会包含哪些源记录中的句子，然后将LLM生成摘要未覆盖的高显著性句子作为候选遗漏呈现出来。我们将OmitEHR应用于简短住院病程（BHC）总结任务，使用了来自一家大型学术医疗中心的5,000例住院数据。在留出的住院数据上，OmitEHR
tldr: OmitEHR通过从LLM普及前临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床显著性，实现了无需参考即可扩展检测LLM生成临床总结中关键信息遗漏的方法。
en_tdlr: OmitEHR is a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries, enabling scalable detection of clinically important omissions in LLM-generated clinical summaries.
